title: Signal blocks phone AI from reading its screens
summary: Signal prevents screenshots on iOS 27 and blocks assistants it can detect on Android. It says it cannot do the same on macOS.

topics.angle: An app closing its window to the operating system’s AI.

claims.text: Signal is preventing screenshots in its app on iOS 27 and when AI assistants try to capture the screen on Android.
Signal calls system-level AI agents an existential threat to it.
Signal says its fix is incomplete, and that it is not blocking Siri AI on macOS.
Signal says Google and Apple, among others, are engaging with it.

to_find: Accessibility users’ view of the block
would_change: A developer opt-out from Apple or Google.

omarchy.why: Apple adding steps before someone else’s agent drives a Mac is the same fight from the owner’s side.
